items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: I was in a movie shot called Lazy Bones with Stephen Fetchley.

ctx.x: to me. You were in the movies, too, huh?

I was in Cab Calloway in the Storm of Weaver. I was in Cab Calloway in Sensation in 1945. I was in a movie shot called Lazy Bones with Stephen Fetchley. I made a movie. Another shot with Martin Downey.
Yeah, I saw you in one of those. Let me see Fields with an impact. Sensations. Sensations in 1925. That was good.

items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Another time, Stepin' Fetchit was in his show.

ctx.x: Another time, Stepin' Fetchit was in his show. Remember him throwin' the bricks and nobody knew where Stepin' Fetchit found them bricks?
